title: One Small Step for Generative AI, One Giant Leap for AGI: A Complete Survey on ChatGPT in AIGC Era

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying existing literature that evaluates the model's ideological leanings by analyzing its generated limericks about politicians and its textual reviews on the importance of political elections in democratic countries.

Reviewing studies on the fairness and financial accessibility of the model, specifically discussing how subscription fees might exacerbate inequality for educational institutions in low- and middle-income countries.
Discussing research on the model's multilingual capabilities and its potential to democratize knowledge dissemination by bypassing the traditional requirement of the English language in academia.
Briefly reviewing comparisons between ChatGPT and other conversational AI models (e.g., LaMDA) regarding their propensity to generate sexist output text.
Briefly reviewing comparisons between ChatGPT and other conversational AI models regarding their propensity to generate racist output text.
